mapper.insert: insert into learning_notification (user_id, from_user_id, type, target_type, target_id, content, is_read, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{fromUserId}, #{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.sql: select n.notification_id, n.user_id, n.from_user_id, n.type, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.content, n.is_read, n.read_time, n.create_time, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = n.from_user_id) as from_user_name, (select u.avatar from sys_user u where u.user_id = n.from_user_id) as from_user_avatar from learning_notification n
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_notification where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = '0'
mapper.update: update learning_notification set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where notification_id = #{notificationId} and user_id = #{userId} and is_read = '0'
